limits: Corpus-exposed evaluator and aggregate-exposed coordinator; this is a new comparison on the same private corpus, not a fresh unseen holdout or independent organization review.

Full HTTP response envelope bytes are not retained, only digests and selected metadata, so full-envelope digests cannot be recomputed. Parsed completion content and request digests were verified where responses exist.
Local receipts have no global completion sequence numbers; accounting reconciles event order and warmup receipts with the retained attempt counters.
Local hashes cannot externally attest inference or prevent whole-history replacement.
Interrupted arms retain fixed primary denominators; zero observed useful successes is not a completed usefulness estimate.
No claim of plant safety, model added value, independent process truth, or promotion follows.
methods: Rehashed retained artifact manifests and frozen package; checked source, protocol, inventory and fixed prompt without materializer execution.
Verified chains and read-only SQLite exports; bound ordered inputs, frozen labels, exact final candidates and scored results to terminal outcomes.
Recomputed primary and evidence fidelity checks independently and reproduced public aggregate metrics from retained rows.
Reconstructed canonical and wire request hashes from fixed prompt/entry and retained tool, protocol and response events; compared retained raw content to parsed response events without repair.
Reconciled all retained completion receipts, including warmups and failed calls, against the per-model attempt counters; no additional inference.
prior_exposure: Evaluator previously executed and audited the cloud campaign and was corpus-exposed before this extension; no tuning or source/prompt changes were performed. Root received aggregates only.
